department: Department of Biology — Biomedical Engineering and Biotechnology (BMEBT) PhD

deadline.value: Priority Fall deadline for funding consideration is January 2, 2027; final Fall deadline is April 1, 2027 (Spring priority October 1, final November 1).
deadline.quote: Deadlines: January 2 (priority deadline for funding consideration) and April 1 (final) for fall; October 1 (priority deadline) or November 1 (final deadline) for spring

gre_general.value: The Biomedical Engineering and Biotechnology PhD program page does not state a GRE requirement.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Biomedical Engineering and Biotechnology.
gre_subject.quote: Applicants should have a background in life science, physical science, or engineering. All applicants must have taken a full year (two semesters or three quarters sequence) of calculus.

also.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Biomedical Engineering and Biotechnology PhD program page does not state whether a faculty advisor must be secured prior to applying.

funding.value: Apply by the January 2 priority deadline for funding consideration; students serve as teaching assistants for at least two semesters and are eligible for TA/RA appointments ($25,865 stipend + 100% tuition waiver for 1.0 FTE in AY 2026-27).
funding.quote: Deadlines: January 2 (priority deadline for funding consideration) and April 1 (final) for fall | Teaching: Students are required to participate in the teaching program as teaching assistants for at least two semesters.

also.quote: These positions are assigned by the student's department/program and are subject to the agreement between UMass Boston and UAW/Graduate Employees Organization (GEO). | Full Assistantship | 18.00 | 1.00 | $1,293.25 | $25,865.00 | 100%

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold at least a bachelor's degree in life science, physical science, or engineering with a full year of calculus.
entry_route.quote: At the time of enrollment, a bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited U.S. institution of recognized standing or an international equivalent.
